violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:white rice=114F, saffron rice=106F, lamb=106F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Rice was discarded during the inspection and the lamb was reheated to above 165F , during the inspection.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Handled Utensils Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped knives, at the self-service station were not stored with the handles up.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): As storage racks to elevate supplies off the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the handle on the sprayer hose located at the food prep sink, leaks and is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Repair the hose properly. Also, remove the plastic wrap on the hose..

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed spray bottles of toxic cleaning chemicals were stored with single service containers, on a shelving, next to the back door entrance to the kitchen. .
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. Train employees to properly store chemicals away from food and food contact utensils, to prevent contamination. (CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.)

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO DISCARD THE MULTIPLE CUPS OF UNCOVERED COFFEE SEEN IN THE PREP AREA OF THE KITCHEN. COFFEE WAS DUMPED.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff handling raw animal foods with gloved hands BUT NOT washing their hands at the hand sink before putting on new gloves. Observed staff putting on gloves but not washing hands first.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS DISCUSSED HAND WASHING PROCEDURES TO INCUDE WHERE, WHEN, AND HOW. SEE FACT SHEET IN SPANISH ON HAND WASHING SENT BY EMAIL.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed a staff member dump coffee into the kitchen hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS DISCUSSED THAT HAND SINKS ARE FOR HAND WASHING ONLY; NO OTHER PURPOSE. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AS NEEDED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed fryer oil stored directly on the floor in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER STORAGE OF FOODS; AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. ENSURE PROPER FOOD STORAGE BEFORE YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Observed towels everywhere. Some are wet, some are dirty.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PUT ALL DIRTY TOWELS IN THE LAUNDERING STORAGE BAG. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO STORE ANY WET TOWELS IN A RED BUCKET WITH SANITIZER. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AS NEEDED. MANAGER CORRECTED VIOLATION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) UTENSILS IN A CONTAINER OF STANDING, ROOM TEMPERATURE WATER FOR RICE, 2) PLASTIC CONTAINERS USED TO DISPENSE BULK FOODS (YOGURT SAUCE, BRAISED LAMB JUICE).
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT ALL FOODS SHALL BE DISPENSED USING A FOOD SCOOP OR UTENSIL DESIGNED WITH A HANDLE. THE HANDLE FOR THE UTENSIL OR SCOOP WILL ALWAYS SIT UP, OUT OF THE FOOD AND NOTHING SHALL BE IN WATER UNLESS IT IS HELD AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES OR THE WATER IS CONSTANTLY RUNNING. MANAGER CORRECTED THE VIOLATION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: 1) COOK LINE LINED WITH ALUMINUM FOIL, 2) DUNNAGE RACK INSIDE THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR LINED WITH CARD BOARD.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO REMOVE THE FOIL AND CARD BOARD AS THEY ARE NOT WASHABLE MATERIALS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the mop sink under pressure and the installation of an unapproved splitter on the thread of the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO ORDER THE PRESSURE BLEED DUAL VALVE IMMEDIATELY. IN THE MEANTIME, REMOVE THE UNAPPROVED SPLITTER FROM THE MOP SINK. ONCE THE PROPER SPLITTER IS ORDERED AND INSTALLED, SEND A PHOTO BY EMAIL TO SHOW PROOF OF CORRECTION.
